simple.summary: מַדְמֵן (Madmên) means Madmen , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Jer 48 2.

definitions.full: H4086. Madmen מַדְמֵן proper name, of a location in Moab Jer 48:2 (on text, however, compare Che Isa 25:10 ).
